title: Comment on T-116 #7 "C-045 part 3 waits on iphone-runner for 2 min #7": Investigate this issue and find the improvement for harden them.

anchor.label: C-045 part 3 waits on iphone-runner for 2 min #7

messages.text: Investigate this issue and find the improvement for harden them.

**I'm on it.** A tools helper is now fixing both causes of the stuck and lost finger tests.

**What went wrong**
- **Stuck Start button (C-045 part 3):** the phone link dropped, and the iPhone helper asked for a redo. It then sent "ready" for the old try. The console ignored it silently, and the helper didn't notice.
- **Lost recording (C-046, your "I felt lag" just now):** the end-of-page recording failed again, this time on a quiet Mac. So Mac load is not the whole cause. Only the end-of-page finger parts lost data; the hero parts and the robot runs never did.

**Hardening being built**
- An old "ready" fails loudly, and the helper's wait shows a clear message instead of hanging.
- The recorder saves frames while it runs, so a dropped link keeps everything up to the drop.
- On a drop, it logs whether the page navigated away (an end flick tapping a link) or stalled.

**Your answer counts:** "I felt lag" at the end is recorded; the robot's end-of-page data is in T-113.

What you need to do: nothing now. I'll ask for one more end-of-page try after the fix lands.

Both problems you reported in the phone step are fixed and on main.

- The grey Start button that never turned on: a wait on a step that was not ready used to hang with no message. Now a stale answer fails loudly and the wait says what it needs (incident I-140).
- The lost finger recording: the phone's page logger is now read every 5 s while recording. If a run ends early, the part already read is saved and marked partial (incident I-141).
- This is a change to how phone records are taken. Runs after it carry the 5 s read; I will not mix it into a block that is already running.

What you need to do: nothing.
